title: Dimension formula on a regular coordinate fibre
statement: Let p:X→S be smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], i:Y→X a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], a,b natural numbers, h:X→A^(a+b)_S an S-map and v:Y→A^a_S etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Assume the square with v,i,h and the inclusion A^a_S→A^(a+b)_S setting the last b coordinates to zero is cartesian [def-pc-base-change], and the pullbacks of those b coordinates form a weakly regular sequence on every affine open of X [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. For y in Y, put x=i(y), s=p(x), and let m:X_s→(A^(a+b)_S)_s be the canonical fibre map, with z the point of X_s corresponding to x. Put L=O_(X_s,z), T=O_((A^(a+b)_S)_s,m(z)), and φ=m_z^#:T→L. Then dim L = dim T + dim(L/m_T L), with Krull dimension [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring] and m_T the maximal ideal of T. This is only a numerical dimension equality; it asserts neither flatness nor etaleness.

proof.text: Choose affine base and source charts at the image of y. The cartesian square identifies Y with the quotient by the last b coordinate functions. The ambient algebra is flat and finitely presented over the base because p is smooth; the quotient is flat because v is etale and affine-space projection is smooth. Localize at i(y). The equations are in the maximal ideal, so the given weak regularity is regularity. Apply relative regular-equation base change to the residue field of the base. This gives a regular sequence of length b in L, the local ring of the fibre of p, with quotient D, the local ring of the fibre of Y. Smoothness over the field makes L Noetherian regular local.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, passage to X_s and Y_s; divisors.tex Tag 0FUD

proof.text: Let T be the local ring of the fibre of affine (a+b)-space at the image of the chosen fibre point. It is a localization of a polynomial ring over the residue field, hence Noetherian regular local. Its last b variables are a regular sequence, since each successive quotient is a polynomial algebra in the remaining variables and localization preserves injectivity. They lie in the maximal ideal at this point, and their quotient is Q, the local ring of affine a-space at v(y). The dimension-drop formula applied b times to the two sequences gives dim L=b+dim D and dim T=b+dim Q. For b=0 both quotient identifications are identities.

source.place: Tag 0FUE, two dimension-drop equalities; algebra.tex Tag 00KW

proof.text: Base change preserves etaleness of v. Apply the affine etale comparison and etale local-dimension equality to get dim D=dim Q. The two dimension-drop equalities give dim L=dim T.

By the cartesian square, the closed fibre of T to L is the closed fibre of Q to D: the coordinate equations vanish in the residue field of T. This is a local ring of a fibre of the etale base change of v, so it is a finite separable field extension and has dimension zero. Thus dim L = dim T + dim(L/m_T L), which is precisely the displayed formula for the stalk map of the canonical pullback map. Every identification is induced by the original maps, so the ideal in the formula is the image of the actual source maximal ideal.

theorem Scheme.Hom.fibre_dimension_formula_of_regular_coordinate_fibre
    {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (p : X ⟶ S) [Smooth p] (i : Y ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (a b : ℕ)
    (h : X ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (a + b))) S)
    (v : Y ⟶ AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) S) [Etale v]
    (hh : h ≫ (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (a + b))) S ↘ S) = p)
    (H : IsPullback v i
      (AffineSpace.homOfVector (AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin a)) S ↘ S)
        (fun j ↦ Fin.addCases (fun k ↦ AffineSpace.coord S (ULift.up k))
          (fun _ ↦ 0) j.down)) h)
    (hreg : ∀ W : X.affineOpens,
      RingTheory.Sequence.IsWeaklyRegular Γ(X, W)
        (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin b ↦
          X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : W.1 ≤ ⊤)).op
            (h.appTop (AffineSpace.coord S (ULift.up (Fin.natAdd a j)))))))
    (y : Y) :
    let q := AffineSpace (ULift.{u} (Fin (a + b))) S ↘ S
    let s := p (i y)
    let m := pullback.map p (S.fromSpecResidueField s) q (S.fromSpecResidueField s)
      h (𝟙 _) (𝟙 S) (by simpa only [Category.comp_id] using hh.symm) (by simp)
    let z := p.asFiber (i y)
    ringKrullDim ((p.fiber s).presheaf.stalk z) =
      ringKrullDim ((q.fiber s).presheaf.stalk (m z)) +
        ringKrullDim (((p.fiber s).presheaf.stalk z) ⧸
          (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((q.fiber s).presheaf.stalk (m z))).map
            (m.stalkMap z).hom)
